= THE KEY

## INT. MARA'S WORKSHOP - NIGHT

MARA, sixties, sleeves rolled, sorts brass keys into a tin under one bare bulb.

@OSKAR
You kept the old key.

@MARA
(not looking up)
I keep every key.

She holds up a small brass key with the red thread tied through its bow.

@OSKAR
Then open the shop door for me.

## EXT. THE SHOP DOOR - CONTINUOUS

Rain on the step. Mara fits the key with the red thread into the lock.

@MARA
It turns the wrong way.

The door opens anyway.

> CUT TO BLACK.
